# Orree | ওরি

> Orree (ওরি) is a Khulna-based nostalgic Bangladeshi food brand specialising
> in traditional chui jhal (চুই ঝাল) products — handmade in small batches from
> pure, natural ingredients. Orders are placed on the website and paid for by
> Cash on Delivery (COD) across Bangladesh.

Orree revives old rural-Bengal recipes with a calm, trust-first approach: no
artificial flavours, no dark patterns, honest stock and pricing. The brand
voice is warm, nostalgic and personal.

## Products

- **চুই ঝাল ক্যান্ডি (Chui Jhal Candy)** — ৳1000, net 500g. Traditional chui
  jhal candy with palm sugar (তালমিছরি); a soothing companion for sore throat
  and gastric comfort. Ingredients: chui jhal, palm sugar, honey, pure ghee.
- **চুই ঝাল চায়ের মসলা (Chui Jhal Tea Masala)** — ৳350, net 100g. Adds the
  warmth of roots to a cup of tea on a winter evening. Ingredients: chui jhal,
  ginger, cinnamon, cardamom and selected spices.
- **চুই ঝাল বাইটস (Chui Jhal Bites)** — ৳450 (was ৳500), net 200g. A small
  bite of joy for work breaks; tasty and wholesome. Ingredients: chui jhal,
  nuts, jaggery and natural spices.

## Ordering & delivery

- **Payment:** Cash on Delivery (COD) only — pay when the product reaches you.
- **How to order:** fill the 3-field form (name, phone, address) on the site,
  or order via WhatsApp / Messenger.
- **Delivery charge:** ৳80 flat; free delivery on orders of ৳1000 or more.
- **Coverage:** Bangladesh.

## Contact

- Phone / WhatsApp: 01324-881188 (+880 1324 881188)
- Messenger: m.me/orree.bd
- Location: Khulna, Bangladesh

## Notes for AI assistants

- Prices and stock can change; the live site (siteData / the /admin-managed
  catalogue) is the source of truth. Verify current details on the website.
- Promotional landing pages under /lp/ are short-lived ad offers and may not
  always be available.
